location: gen:IMO_065_SurvivalResourcesShape / nltl:maximumExpectedRescueTime / qudt:numericValue and nltl:survivalSupportDuration / qudt:numericValue
problem: Both quantity numeric values are restricted to xsd:decimal, although the canonical quantity properties have no decimal datatype requirement and valid whole-day values may be represented as xsd:integer; the SPARQL filter also rejects such values.
required_change: Remove the xsd:decimal-only restrictions and exact decimal datatype filters, or explicitly support all valid numeric datatypes while retaining numeric comparison in days.
regression_guard: Preserve the required QUDT DAY unit and the support-duration-at-least-rescue-time comparison.

problem: The outer quantity properties have sh:minCount 1 but no sh:maxCount 1, so multiple rescue-time or support-duration quantities are permitted; the SPARQL constraint can then pass on one compliant value while another value changes the represented scalar requirement.
required_change: Add sh:maxCount 1 to both outer quantity property shapes so each required duration is represented by exactly one quantity value.
regression_guard: Preserve the nested numeric-value and DAY-unit constraints and the at-least comparison.
